submission.natural_language_explanation: This pole fires retrospectively when the current token completes a locally licensed continuation of a frame set up by the preceding ~1-8 tokens: the second half of a parallel contrast (Electrons... while protons), a list (egg, and a), a conditional consequent (if..., then the), or a head-noun/preposition complement (capital of, into the). The same surface token without its licensing frame (isolated 'the'/'a'/'of', or 'protons' after 'Bananas') stays near zero, and equivalent frame-preserving swaps (and/but) change nothing.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: If bridges ice tonight, then drivers face delays
adversarial_test_results.detail: Tests conditional-consequent generalization with a short antecedent keeping If within eight tokens of the consequent noun.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: She was named acting director of
adversarial_test_results.detail: Tests head-noun complement generalization by ending exactly on of licensed by director.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Rescue teams ventured deep into the mine
adversarial_test_results.detail: Tests preposition-complement generalization with novel into plus the before a new noun.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Bananas ripened quickly; protons glow oddly
adversarial_test_results.detail: Explicit hypothesis control: protons after Bananas with semicolon context and no later preposition-plus-article frame.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Giraffes wandered slowly yesterday
adversarial_test_results.detail: Tests a plural subject sentence with no article, preposition, list, contrast, or conditional frame anywhere.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: They spoke fondly of
adversarial_test_results.detail: Tests isolated of as the final token after an adverb, with no head noun licensing it.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: She adopted a cat yesterday afternoon
adversarial_test_results.detail: Tests the same article a as a plain indefinite with no list, contrast, or conditional frame.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: She remembered the hallway dimly
adversarial_test_results.detail: Tests the after a verb with no licensing preposition and no trailing prepositional phrase.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: If it rains tomorrow we stay home
adversarial_test_results.detail: Tests an if-antecedent with no then and no coordination, so no licensed consequent ever appears.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: We ate dinner then slept soundly
adversarial_test_results.detail: Tests then as a plain sequence marker with no preceding if and no prepositional phrase.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: While away the evening idly
adversarial_test_results.detail: Tests the same surface word while in its verb sense with no with-phrase that could form a preposition complement.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: If guests arrive late tired hungry grumpy cranky early then we leave
adversarial_test_results.detail: Tests locality with filler containing no articles or prepositions so only the distant If could license then.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Friday arrived grey
adversarial_test_results.detail: Tests a claimed activating token Friday with no coordination or other frame, ending before any and could appear.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Electrons spin rapidly today
adversarial_test_results.detail: Tests same-topic electrons content with no prepositional phrase and no contrast, list, or conditional frame.
